wnba.Headline: Leila Lacan scores career-high 26 points, Sun beat Mercury 96-83
wnba.Description: — Leila Lacan scored a career-high 26 points on 10-of-13 shooting from the field to lead the Connecticut Sun to a 96-83 victory over the Phoenix Mercury on Friday night in the first of back-to-back meetings between the teams.

wnba.Headline: Phoenix Mercury vs. Connecticut Sun - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Phoenix Mercury vs. Connecticut Sun, 07/17/2026

wnba.Headline: Fever's Caitlin Clark records WNBA's 1st 45-point, 10-assist double-double
wnba.Description: Caitlin Clark scored a career-high 45 points and had 10 assists for the first 40-10 game in WNBA history, and the Indiana Fever beat Seattle 110-107.

wnba.Headline: Caitlin Clark has 45 points, 10 assists for the WNBA's first 40-10 game as Fever beat Storm
wnba.Description: — Caitlin Clark scored a career-high 45 points and had 10 assists for the first 40-10 game in WNBA history, and the Indiana Fever beat Seattle 110-107 on Friday night.

wnba.Headline: Naz Hillmon has perfect shooting night in the Dream's victory over the Tempo
wnba.Description: — Naz Hillmon scored 24 points on a perfect shooting night to help the Atlanta Dream, beat the Toronto Tempo 111-92 on Friday.

wnba.Headline: Sydney Taylor, Sky beat Sparks as Nneka Ogwumike becomes LA's career scoring leader
wnba.Description: — Sydney Taylor hit four 3-pointers and scored 19 points and the Chicago Sky beat Los Angeles 96-82 on Friday night as Nneka Ogwumike became the Sparks’ career scoring leader.

wnba.Headline: Fire hold the Mystics to 29% shooting in a 75-56 rout

wnba.Headline: NBA's Silver says Fever's Clark has become 'political football'
wnba.Description: NBA commissioner Adam Silver said Fever star Caitlin Clark has become a "political football" amid debates about officiating and physical play in the WNBA.

wnba.Headline: Igor Kokoskov joins Project B as head of player development
wnba.Description: Longtime NBA assistant Igor Kokoskov has joined the startup men's and women's basketball league Project B as its head of player development, the organization announced Thursday.
